title: Activation Steering Transfer to Agents: One Gain Ratio Does Not Identify Potency and Efficacy
abstract: arXiv:2607.09156v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Additive activation steering is calibrated in single-turn chat and then deployed inside agent scaffolds. The quantity usually reported for that move is a gain: a ratio of steered effects, T = Delta_agent / Delta_chat. We sweep eight family x arm dose-response cells over six models in both deployment contexts and show this ratio does not identify potency and efficacy. Reconstructing the published estimator in both of its forms on our own grids, its realized range contains 1 in five of five scorable cells, it moves with dose in four of five, and two cells with opposite, CI-clean potency shifts return gain intervals overlapping at a width under 0.08. Every scorable cell is an amplifier at one dose and an attenuator at another, so an amplify/attenuate taxonomy reports the dose it was read at.   We replace the gain with a location: dEC50 = EC50_agent - EC50_chat, the cross-context difference in a curve location. It is two-sided across fou

translated_title: 激活引导向智能体的迁移：单一增益比无法识别效价与效能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.09156v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：加性激活引导在单轮对话中校准，然后部署到智能体框架内。该操作通常报告的指标是增益：即引导效果的比例，T = Δ智能体 / Δ对话。我们在六种模型上、两种部署环境中扫描了八个家族×臂的剂量反应单元，并表明该比例无法识别效价和效能。在我们自己的网格上以两种形式重建已发表的估计器，其实际范围在五个可评分单元中的五个包含1，在五个中的四个随剂量变化，而两个具有相反、置信区间清晰的效价变化的单元返回的增益区间重叠宽度低于0.08。每个可评分单元在一种剂量下是放大器，在另一种剂量下是衰减器，因此放大/衰减分类法报告的是其读取时的剂量。我们用位置替代增益：dEC50 = EC50智能体 - EC50对话，即曲线位置的跨上下文差异。它在四个单元中是双侧的。
tldr: 该论文发现激活引导的增益比无法可靠评估智能体部署中的效价和效能，并提出用跨上下文的EC50位置差异（dEC50）作为更稳健的替代指标。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the gain ratio in activation steering fails to reliably assess potency and efficacy in agent deployment, proposing the cross-context EC50 location difference (dEC50) as a more robust alternative metric.
